rationale: Sotomayor, as the most senior justice in the majority, will likely assign the opinion to herself or to Barrett/Kagan given their persuasive articulations of the 'distinct legal spaces' limiting principle that can attract the broadest coalition. Thomas and Alito are near-certain to write separately in dissent, while Kavanaugh's close vote and Roberts's acknowledged uncertainty make separate dissenting writings likely from them as well, with Gorsuch potentially writing separately to emphasize his textualist rationale for joining the majority.
